existing_block_predictor_reproduction.interpretation: Reproduces the known ~1.85-1.9 bps hard-residual regime before learned probability coding.

training_free_context_mixer.method: online adaptive causal categorical context tables with lightweight probability mixing; no offline training or transmitted model
training_free_context_mixer.note: Class-rate diagnostic only; does not include all tail/framing/selector costs. Not a codec gain claim.
training_free_context_mixer.verdict: valid direction but insufficient margin for 2x

fractional_block_predictor.method: decoder-known blockwise fractional spatial predictors using already reconstructed traces; exact error-bounded recursive reconstruction
fractional_block_predictor.verdict: real raw-residual improvement, but not sufficient alone

fractional_predictor_plus_probability_ml.training: two deterministic different Waka regions; hard tile held out
fractional_predictor_plus_probability_ml.verdict: worse than original learned probability representation; mechanisms are not complementary

waveform_motif_codebook.method: MiniBatchKMeans causal waveform-state codebook plus per-state residual probability table

learned_probability_feature_ablation.training: same two different Waka regions; hard tile held out
learned_probability_feature_ablation.interpretation: The learned gain is dominated by causal waveform-shape information: current temporal shape, neighboring decoded waveform windows, and relative waveform geometry. Residual-history tables contribute materially but are secondary. The next fast algorithm should target waveform-shape conditional probability rather than more residual-only contexts.

discarded_in_this_work_block: 2-D multigrid hierarchy on the 4x32 hard tile: slow-axis interpolation too weak
waveform-transport predictor from neighbor time increments: no improvement
hashed nonlinear adaptive contexts: approximately 1.70 bps class rate, insufficient
simple linear probability model: approximately 1.39 bps on held-out hard region, insufficient
next_research_target: Derive a compact causal waveform-shape conditional model that approximates the probability MLP without expensive per-file neural training; prioritize analytic/local-template phase-amplitude state representations and preserve the proven non-neural portfolio as a monotonic fallback.
